# Exact versions frozen with pip to stop CI dependency drift. Pulls in the
# pinned runtime lock, then adds the dev/test/build tools. Edit ranges in
# requirements-dev.in, then regenerate:
#
#   python -m venv .venv-lock
#   .venv-lock/Scripts/pip install -r requirements-dev.in   # bin/ on Unix
#   .venv-lock/Scripts/pip freeze > frozen.txt
#   # rebuild this file from frozen.txt: keep the "-r requirements.txt" line,
#   # list only the packages not already in requirements.txt, and re-apply the
#   # OS markers below (a Windows freeze omits macholib; a Linux/macOS freeze
#   # omits pefile/pywin32-ctypes/colorama).
#
# Resolved on Python 3.12. OS markers keep the release matrix (Linux, Windows,
# macOS) installing cleanly from this one lock: the marked lines are PyInstaller
# and pytest build-time deps that only exist on one platform.
